scene_target: Rhea and Vance rapidly allocate stats and manage inventory to survive the violent influx of rewards.
goal: Allocate stats and manage inventory fast enough to survive the physical crush of the XP/loot refund.
conflict: The sheer volume of back-paid XP and physical items threatens to crush them or overload their physical capacities before they can process it.
required_callbacks: Vance's HP is critically low (2/100) after taking concussive damage from a shattered XP shard.
The sky is glitching into a violent purple as the 14.3% withheld value rains down.
constraints: Must show rapid, panicked stat allocation and inventory management.
Do not resolve the storm subsiding; the storm must still be raging at the end of the scene.
Maintain Eldrik Vale's comedic tone regarding the absurdity of being physically crushed by bureaucratic payouts.
end_condition: Rhea and Vance successfully allocate enough stats and clear enough inventory space to stabilize their immediate survival against the ongoing refund storm.
transition_in_text: The party is trapped under the crushing physical weight of the unallocated rewards as the refund storm intensifies.
transition_out_text: Rhea and Vance manage to allocate just enough stats and inventory space to keep from being crushed, though the storm still rages.

chapter_so_far_add: Trapped under the crushing weight of the physical refund, Rhea and Vance rapidly allocated stats and expanded their inventories to survive.
key_events: The 14.3% withheld value rained down on the Outpost Surface as dangerous physical objects.
Rhea and Vance rapidly leveled up and allocated stat points to survive the crushing mass.
Rhea increased her Strength and Vitality, raising her encumbrance limit.
Vance's HP increased to 15/150 after leveling up.
Both characters purchased additional system inventory slots to stow the physical loot.
The party stabilized their immediate survival, but the storm continued.
last_scene: Trapped under the crushing physical weight of the unallocated rewards, the party struggled to breathe as the refund storm intensified.
Rhea and Vance were forced to rapidly allocate stats and expand their inventory slots to avoid being physically crushed by the back-pay.
Rhea dumped points into Strength and Vitality to increase her encumbrance limit.
Vance leveled up, pulling his HP just out of the critical red zone.
They managed to clear enough space to survive, though the storm continued to rage.
